page.notes: Small mark at left margin beside the line "signum", possibly a printed reference sign; not read as text. Greek passages in the glosses are uncertain and marked [?]; the Greek on the "Aristophanes" line and the line after "Ridere licet" are especially doubtful. "etatque" may be a misprint for "etiamque" but is copied as printed. "suinicorum", "inebra" and "se-ruissent" are unclear. The running head is set in small capitals and the page number is printed at top left.
